name: Guess the Crop
tagline: Predict next year's crop from the rotation pattern.
description: Spatial-temporal reasoning, not color guessing. We show you a target field with a rust outline plus six to eight neighbor fields. Each neighbor is painted with three years of CDL crop history as horizontal ribbons (Y-3 top, Y-1 bottom). You read the rotation pattern and predict what the target planted this year. Eight realistic CONUS clusters - corn-soy, wheat-fallow, rice-soy delta, wheat-canola-soy, alfalfa-corn, more. The educational lift is the temporal rotation pattern that makes satellite ag-data interpretable.
